project.name: PF2e Kingmaker Tools — Kingdom Subsystem
project.description: The Kingdom-management subsystem of the Foundry VTT module 'Kingdom Building, Camping & Weather' for Pathfinder 2e Kingmaker. Covers kingdom data models (commonMain), the turn/economy engine, activities, structures/settlements, the war/army board and pacing alerts, plus the Kotlin/JS UI layer (ApplicationV2 dialogs and Handlebars templates).

nodes.summary: Unit tests for RawCharacter factory defaults, field mutation, and the toRosterContext extension, plus smoke tests verifying Migration24 null-companion handling.

nodes.name: CompanionProfileContextTest.kt
nodes.summary: Unit tests for buildCompanionProfileContext, verifying GM vs player quest visibility, influence clamping, bar percentage, and discovery stage selection.

nodes.name: CompanionQuestRowsTest.kt
nodes.summary: Unit tests for buildCompanionQuestRows and companionHasActivePersonalQuests, covering GM/player filtering, companion-index resolution, and deletion-guard logic.

nodes.name: PartyInfluenceContextTest.kt
nodes.summary: Unit tests for buildPartyInfluenceContext and withInfluence, verifying per-pair influence storage, clamping, bar percent, and immutability of the receiver array.

nodes.name: DailyTickHooks.kt
nodes.summary: Registers Foundry world-clock hooks that fire on each calendar day boundary: rolls daily weather and advances traveling companion tokens toward their destination hex using cubic hex math.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Foundry's onUpdateWorldTime hook with hex cubic-coordinate arithmetic (cubeRound, cubeLerpStep, cubeDistance) compiled to Kotlin/JS.

nodes.name: KingdomData.kt
nodes.summary: Central kingdom data model: defines KingdomData and KingdomSettings JsPlainObject interfaces plus extension functions for parsing ability scores, skill ranks, ruins, vacancies, leader actors, and settlements.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses @JsPlainObject external interfaces for direct JS interop; extension functions on KingdomData keep the interface lean while providing rich domain logic.

nodes.name: KingdomMilestone.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the RawMilestone interface and helpers for loading, translating, and merging built-in and homebrew kingdom milestones into the active milestone list.

nodes.name: Armies.kt
nodes.summary: Provides army management utilities: retrieving selected and recruitable PF2E armies from the Foundry game, bootstrapping the army folder, and importing basic compendium armies on first setup.

nodes.name: MilestoneChoice.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the minimal MilestoneChoice JsPlainObject interface recording whether a milestone is enabled and completed on a per-kingdom basis.

nodes.name: RawCharacter.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the RawCharacter JsPlainObject interface for companion/NPC roster entries, including travel state, influence, discovery status, and personal quest IDs, plus a factory function with sensible defaults.

nodes.name: RawFeat.kt
nodes.summary: Defines ChosenFeat data class and getChosenFeats extension on KingdomData, assembling the full list of active kingdom feats from features, government bonus feats, and manually added bonus feats.

nodes.name: RawLevelUpChoices.kt
nodes.summary: Defines JsPlainObject interfaces for all kingdom level-up choices (charter, heartland, government, ability boosts, features, ruin thresholds) along with helper extension functions for parsing and querying them.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of @JsPlainObject external interfaces to mirror Foundry actor flag schema; RuinThresholdIncreases is a pure Kotlin data class using operator overloading.

nodes.name: RawPartyMemberInfluence.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the RawPartyMemberInfluence JsPlainObject interface storing the per-(companion, party-member) influence score used by the Party Influence matrix panel.

nodes.name: RawQuest.kt
nodes.summary: Defines RawQuest and RawQuestRewards JsPlainObject interfaces representing a kingdom quest with its type, status, target, and optional commodity/RP/XP rewards.

nodes.name: AddQuest.kt
nodes.summary: ApplicationV2 FormApp dialog for creating or editing a kingdom quest, including a DataModel schema, form-row context builder, and save handler that assembles a RawQuest with rewards.

nodes.name: ArmyBrowser.kt
nodes.summary: ApplicationV2 SimpleApp dialog that lists recruitable PF2E armies and workbook basic army stats, then triggers a kingdom check dialog when the GM clicks Recruit Army.

nodes.name: ArmyTacticsBrowser.kt
nodes.summary: ApplicationV2 SimpleApp dialog listing available tactics for a selected PF2E army and firing a Train Army kingdom check when the GM clicks a tactic row.

nodes.name: MilestoneManagement.kt
nodes.summary: CrudApplication dialog for managing kingdom milestones: lists built-in and homebrew milestones with completion/enable state, and supports adding, editing, and deleting homebrew entries.

nodes.name: RosterPanel.kt
nodes.summary: Provides RosterAddDialog and RosterEditDialog ApplicationV2 dialogs for adding and editing companions/NPCs on the kingdom roster, including travel, influence, and discovery-status fields.

nodes.name: StructureChatMessages.kt
nodes.summary: Builds the degree-of-success chat message payloads for structure construction rolls, including cost labels, halved costs on critical success, ruin-reduce/gain buttons, and Handlebars template rendering.

nodes.name: BeforeKingdomUpdate.kt
nodes.summary: Pre-save hook that cleans feat ruin-threshold overrides when feats change, resets ability boosts when charter/government changes, calculates and applies milestone XP, and checks ruin threshold breaches with chat messages.

nodes.name: CalculateUnrest.kt
nodes.summary: Calculates and applies kingdom unrest from overcrowding, war, and vacant-ruler sources, posting chat messages and triggering anarchy/hex-loss checks at high unrest thresholds.

nodes.name: ObsidianIntegration.kt
nodes.summary: Provides KingdomJournalExporter (export kingdom state to Foundry journal) and ObsidianImporter (parse YAML-frontmatter Markdown to import notes, companions, leaders, or quests into kingdom data).

nodes.name: ResourceButton.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the ResourceButton data class with Resource and ResourceMode enums, HTML rendering, string/HTML parsing, and an evaluate function that applies resource changes (RP, dice, commodities, ruin, events) to KingdomData.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Kotlin regex with named capture groups to parse shorthand @gainXResourceY button syntax into typed ResourceButton instances.

nodes.name: Xp.kt
nodes.summary: XP and level management utilities: XpChange data class, calculateXpChange and calculateMilestoneXp pure functions, and gainXp/levelUp suspend extension functions on KingdomActor with chat message feedback.

nodes.name: CompanionProfileContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the CompanionProfileContext Handlebars context interface and buildCompanionProfileContext pure builder that maps a RawCharacter and personal quests to the companion-profile panel, with GM vs player visibility rules.

nodes.name: CompanionQuestContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines CompanionQuestRowContext and the buildCompanionQuestRows pure builder mapping personal quests to quests-page table rows with companion resolution and GM/player filtering; also provides the companionHasActivePersonalQuests deletion guard.

nodes.name: KingdomSheetContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the top-level KingdomSheetContext Handlebars interface aggregating all sub-contexts (quests, resources, roster, party influence, army pressure, pacing alerts, milestones, activities, council) for the main kingdom sheet.

nodes.name: MilestoneContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the MilestoneContext Handlebars interface and a toContext extension on Array<MilestoneChoice> that builds sorted, visibility-filtered milestone rows with checkbox and hidden-input form elements.

nodes.name: PartyInfluenceContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the Party Influence matrix context interfaces and pure builders buildPartyInfluenceContext and withInfluence, grouping per-(companion, party-member) influence values with bar percentages.

nodes.name: RosterContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines RosterActorContext and RosterContext Handlebars interfaces and the toRosterContext extension on Array<RawCharacter> that produces enriched roster rows with travel labels, influence bars, and active-quest counts.

nodes.name: registerDailyTickHooks
nodes.summary: Registers the Foundry onUpdateWorldTime hook that triggers daily weather rolls and companion token travel on each calendar day boundary.

nodes.name: advanceCompanionTravel
nodes.summary: Advances a single companion's token by the appropriate number of hexes using ETA pacing or speed-based movement, returning true when the destination is reached.

nodes.name: parseSkillRanks
nodes.summary: Computes final KingdomSkillRanks from chosen features and feats when automateStats is on, or reads raw values directly when off.

nodes.name: parseAbilityScores
nodes.summary: Derives KingdomAbilityScores from all charter/heartland/government/feature boost sources when automateStats is on, otherwise returns raw values.

nodes.name: createModifiers
nodes.summary: Computes the full list of kingdom Modifiers from settlements and optional army conditions, evaluating global bonuses and capital item fallback.

nodes.name: getAllSettlements
nodes.summary: Resolves all RawSettlement entries to parsed Settlement domain objects via their Foundry scene IDs, identifying the capital and active settlement.

nodes.name: executeResourceButton
nodes.summary: Handles a resource button click: parses the button from the HTML element, evaluates the resource change against current kingdom state, runs beforeKingdomUpdate, and persists the result.

nodes.name: buildCompanionProfileContext
nodes.summary: Pure builder for CompanionProfileContext from a RawCharacter and personal quests, enforcing GM/player visibility and clamping influence values.

nodes.name: buildPartyInfluenceContext
nodes.summary: Pure builder for the Party Influence matrix context, mapping (companion, party-member) pairs to clamped influence values with bar percentages.

nodes.name: beforeKingdomUpdate
nodes.summary: Pre-save lifecycle hook that clears stale feat overrides, resets ability boosts on political changes, calculates milestone XP delta, and validates ruin thresholds with chat feedback.

nodes.name: adjustUnrest
nodes.summary: Calculates new kingdom unrest from all sources, posts a chat summary, and applies level-20 immunity, anarchy, and hex-loss checks.

nodes.name: buildCompanionQuestRows
nodes.summary: Pure builder mapping CompanionPersonalQuest entries to quests-page table rows with companion-name and index resolution, respecting GM/player filtering.

nodes.name: TurnWizardApplication.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the TurnWizardApplication Foundry dialog and the performEndTurn top-level function; the dialog presents a turn checklist, kingdom state summary, activity-cap validation, tick preview, and commit/cancel actions wiring into TurnTickingEngine and pacing-alert tracking.

nodes.name: TurnWizardApplication
nodes.summary: SimpleApp dialog orchestrating the kingdom End Turn wizard: checklist persistence via actor flags, tick preview (dry-run), commit via performEndTurn, and static buildContext/buildContextWithPreview helpers used by tests.

nodes.name: performEndTurn
nodes.summary: Suspending function that increments the kingdom turn counter, invokes TurnTickingEngine.tick, applies the TickResult to KingdomData, ticks campaign clocks, fires pacing alerts (unrest stagnation, level mismatch, loot imbalance), persists via setKingdom, and posts chat messages.

nodes.name: Defaults.kt
nodes.summary: Provides the createKingdomDefaults factory function that constructs a fully-initialised KingdomData object with sensible zero-state defaults for all settings, resources, leaders, skills, feats, and optional subsystems.

nodes.name: createKingdomDefaults
nodes.summary: Factory function that builds and returns a fully-populated KingdomData with all fields initialised to canonical defaults, used when creating a new kingdom actor.

nodes.name: KingdomSheetData.kt
nodes.summary: Declares the KingdomSheetData JsPlainObject external interface aggregating all top-level kingdom actor data fields consumed by the Handlebars sheet template.

nodes.name: Turn.kt
nodes.summary: Declares the Turn enum (NOW/NEXT) implementing Translatable and ValueEnum, used to distinguish current-turn versus next-turn resource buckets in UI contexts.

nodes.name: Turn
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing NOW vs NEXT kingdom resource buckets, providing camelCase value serialisation and i18n keys.

nodes.name: AbilityScoresContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the AbilityScoreContext interface and the RawAbilityScores.toContext extension that converts raw ability score values into form-element contexts with computed modifier strings for the kingdom sheet.

nodes.name: toContext

nodes.name: CommodityContext.kt

nodes.name: ConsumptionContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the ConsumptionContext interface and the RawConsumption.toContext extension that produces three NumberInput form-element contexts for armies, now, and next consumption fields.

nodes.name: FameContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the FameContext interface and the RawFame.toContext extension that produces Select-range inputs for now/next fame points and a fame-type enum select bounded by the configured maximum.

nodes.name: LeadersContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines ActorLeaderContext and LeaderValuesContext interfaces and toContext extensions on RawLeaderValues and RawLeaders that assemble per-leader form inputs (invested checkbox, type select, vacant checkbox) incorporating actor data and leadership bonus values.

nodes.name: toContext
nodes.summary: Extension function on RawLeaders that maps all eight leader roles to LeaderValuesContext objects by calling per-role toContext with actor data, bonus, and vacancy information.

nodes.name: NotesContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the NotesContext interface and the suspending RawNotes.toContext extension that enriches raw and GM note HTML via Foundry TextEditor for display in the kingdom sheet.

nodes.name: ResourceContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the ResourceContext interface and the RawResources.toContext extension that produces NumberInput form-element contexts for now and next resource point/dice fields.

nodes.name: RuinContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the RuinContext interface and toInput/toContext extensions on RawRuinValues and RawRuin that produce Select and NumberInput form-element contexts for each of the four ruin categories, optionally automating threshold display.

nodes.name: LeaderBonuses.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the LeaderBonuses data class holding per-role leadership bonus integers, and the getHighestLeadershipModifiers top-level function that resolves actor-based bonuses for all eight kingdom leader roles.

nodes.name: getHighestLeadershipModifiers
nodes.summary: Iterates all eight Leader enum entries, resolves each actor's leadership bonus via calculateLeadershipBonus, and returns a populated LeaderBonuses instance.

nodes.name: TurnTickingEngine.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the monthly kingdom-turn ticking engine as a singleton object; processes End Turn state transitions including fame advancement, resource/consumption rollover, commodity storage capping, council cooldowns, modifier expiry, campaign clock ticking, quest timer decrement, and war threat/pressure recalculation — with no Foundry dependencies for full unit-testability.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Kotlin object singleton; tick() is a pure function accepting snapshots and returning a TickResult, enabling deterministic testing without mocks.

nodes.name: TurnTickingEngine
nodes.summary: Singleton object that encapsulates all monthly kingdom-turn tick logic, exposing tick() and tickQuests() as pure functions.

nodes.name: tick
nodes.summary: Core tick function that applies all End Turn state transitions against provided kingdom state snapshots and returns a TickResult with post-tick values and a change audit list.

nodes.name: tickQuests
nodes.summary: Decrements turnsRemaining on active generated quests and marks expired ones as FAILED, returning updated quest array and TickChange entries.

nodes.name: RawAbilityScores.kt
nodes.summary: Declares the RawAbilityScores JsPlainObject external interface with the four kingdom ability score fields (economy, stability, loyalty, culture) used for JS interop.

nodes.name: RawCommodities.kt
nodes.summary: Defines RawCommodities and RawCurrentCommodities JsPlainObject interfaces for the five resource types, plus limitBy and endTurn extension functions that cap and roll over commodity values at End Turn.

nodes.name: RawConsumption.kt
nodes.summary: Declares the RawConsumption JsPlainObject interface (armies, now, next) and an endTurn extension that rolls next into now.

nodes.name: RawFame.kt
nodes.summary: Declares the RawFame JsPlainObject interface holding the kingdom's current, next, and type (famous/infamous) fame fields for JS interop.

nodes.name: RawLeaders.kt
nodes.summary: Declares RawLeaderValues and RawLeaders JsPlainObject interfaces covering the eight kingdom leadership roles, each with uuid, invested, type, and vacant fields.

nodes.name: RawNotes.kt
nodes.summary: Declares the RawNotes JsPlainObject interface with public and gm text fields for kingdom note storage.

nodes.name: RawResources.kt
nodes.summary: Declares the RawResources JsPlainObject interface (now/next integer pair) used for both resource points and resource dice, plus an endTurn extension that rolls next into now.

nodes.name: RawRuin.kt
nodes.summary: Declares RawRuinValues and RawRuin JsPlainObject interfaces for the four ruin categories (corruption, crime, decay, strife), with parse extension functions that convert them to domain RuinValue/RuinValues objects.

nodes.name: RawSkillRanks.kt
nodes.summary: Declares the RawSkillRanks JsPlainObject interface with integer rank fields for all sixteen kingdom skills used for JS interop.

nodes.name: HexContentManager.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the HexContentManager Foundry ApplicationV2 dialog for CRUD management of hex map annotations; supports add/edit/delete/reveal/hide/clear actions and renders a dynamic form with type, visibility, and metadata fields via Handlebars context.

nodes.name: HexContentManager
nodes.summary: FormApp dialog that manages kingdom hex content entries, handling add/edit/delete/visibility lifecycle and building Handlebars render context for the manager template.

nodes.name: HexContentManagerModel
nodes.summary: Foundry DataModel subclass that defines the validation schema for hex content form data including hexKey, type, name, visibility, and optional linked fields.

nodes.name: SkillRanksContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the SkillRanksContext interface and the RawSkillRanks.toContext extension that produces sixteen NumberInput form-element contexts — one per kingdom skill — for display on the kingdom sheet.

nodes.name: toContext
nodes.summary: Extension function on RawSkillRanks that builds a SkillRanksContext by constructing a NumberInput form context for each of the sixteen kingdom skills.

nodes.name: TurnWizardContext.kt
nodes.summary: Declares the Handlebars render context interfaces for the Turn Wizard dialog: ChecklistItemContext, KingdomStateContext, ActivityCapContext, TickChangeContext, and the top-level TurnWizardContext.

nodes.name: ActivityCapCalculatorTest.kt
nodes.summary: Unit tests for ActivityCapCalculator verifying that the leadership activity cap defaults to 2 and increases to 3 when the increaseLeadershipActivities setting is enabled.

nodes.name: TurnTickingEngineTest.kt
nodes.summary: Comprehensive unit tests for TurnTickingEngine covering fame advancement, resource point/dice rollover, consumption rollover, commodity end-turn merging with storage caps, council cooldown ticking, modifier expiry, and war threat/pressure tick logic.

nodes.name: TurnWizardApplicationTest.kt
nodes.summary: Unit tests for TurnWizardApplication.buildContext verifying checklist item presence, unrest highlight logic, kingdom state summary correctness, TickChange display string formatting, and preview/commit state.

nodes.name: DowngradeResult.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the DowngradeResult data class representing a degree-of-success downgrade with an optional repeat count, used by the modifier system to adjust kingdom check outcomes.

nodes.name: ModifierSelector.kt
nodes.summary: Declares the ModifierSelector enum identifying which kingdom resource or roll category a modifier targets (CHECK, ORE, STONE, LUMBER, CONSUMPTION), with i18n and camelCase serialization support.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements Translatable and ValueEnum interfaces via Kotlin enum; uses toCamelCase/fromCamelCase for JSON-safe string keys.

nodes.name: Note.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the Note data class carrying a text note and an optional DegreeOfSuccess filter, attached to modifiers to surface conditional roll notes in chat.

nodes.name: UpgradeResult.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the UpgradeResult data class representing a degree-of-success upgrade with a repeat count, counterpart to DowngradeResult in the modifier evaluation pipeline.

nodes.name: FilterModifiers.kt
nodes.summary: Implements filterModifiersAndUpdateContext which filters a modifier list by selector, evaluates applyIf predicates against an ExpressionContext, and returns active modifiers with updated roll options.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-pass filtering: first pass collects roll options from enabled modifiers, second pass re-evaluates predicates with the enriched context — avoids ordering sensitivity.

nodes.name: filterModifiersAndUpdateContext
nodes.summary: Filters modifiers by selector and evaluates applyIf predicates in two passes, updating the ExpressionContext with active roll options and returning the filtered result.

nodes.name: ModifierResult.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the ModifierResult data class aggregating evaluated modifier state: total bonus, breakdown by type, fortune/reroll flags, upgrade/downgrade sets, and assurance value.

nodes.name: ExpressionContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines ExpressionContext, the evaluation environment for modifier predicates, mapping @-prefixed token strings to live kingdom state values (skills, leader, phase, ruin, structures, etc.) plus Boolean/Int parse helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Central expression evaluator uses a when-expression over string tokens; parseBooleanOrFalse handles mixed Any? return types from JS interop.

nodes.name: evaluateExpression
nodes.summary: Resolves @-prefixed token strings to their corresponding live kingdom state values; acts as the runtime dispatch table for the modifier predicate mini-language.

nodes.name: Consumption.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the Consumption data class and calculateConsumption function which tallies settlement, army, and modifier-based food consumption against farmland/food resources to produce the net kingdom food deficit.

nodes.name: calculateConsumption
nodes.summary: Calculates kingdom food consumption by summing settlement, army, and modifier costs, then subtracting farmland and stored food to yield the net deficit and surplus values.

nodes.name: Income.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the Income data class holding per-turn commodity gains and resource dice, plus calculateIncome which derives raw income from realm worksite data and kingdom size.

nodes.name: calculateIncome
nodes.summary: Derives base income from realm worksite quantities (quarries, mines, lumber camps, luxury sources) and the kingdom's resource die size based on its size tier.

nodes.name: ActivityCapCalculator.kt
nodes.summary: Provides ActivityCapCalculator singleton and related data classes for computing per-phase kingdom activity caps (leadership, civic, region, army, commerce) from KingdomData and performed activity counts.

nodes.name: KingdomFeat.kt
nodes.summary: Declares the RawFeat JS interop interface and associated extension functions for parsing, validating requirements (feat prerequisites, skill ranks, ability scores), and translating feat text for the kingdom feat system.
nodes.languageNotes: @JsPlainObject external interfaces map Kotlin types to plain JS objects from feats.json; unsafeCast used for Record<String,Int> since Kotlin/JS lacks direct typed Records.

nodes.name: satisfiesRequirements
nodes.summary: Validates that a RawFeat's prerequisites (required feat IDs, ability score minimums, skill rank minimums) are met given the current kingdom state.

nodes.name: RawActivity.kt
nodes.summary: Declares the RawActivity JS interop interface, the global activity registry, and extension functions for translating, filtering, resolving DCs, and checking performability of kingdom turn activities.
nodes.languageNotes: Activities loaded from kingdom-activities.json via @JsModule; translate() + translateActivities() must be called at startup to inject localized strings and event-buttons into activity text.

nodes.name: resolveDc
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective DC for a kingdom activity, dispatching over DC type (control, negotiation, scouting, custom, numeric) and applying any dcAdjustment offset.

nodes.name: ReRolls.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the kingdom roll meta system: generateRollMeta serializes all roll parameters into a Handlebars chat message context, and reRoll replays a check from a chat message DOM element supporting fame/infamy, creative solution, free-and-fair, and reroll modes.

nodes.name: generateRollMeta
nodes.summary: Serializes all kingdom roll parameters (modifier pills, upgrade/downgrade sets, notes, actor UUID, event context) into a base64-JSON RollMetaContext for embedding in Foundry chat messages.

nodes.name: reRoll
nodes.summary: Extracts roll metadata from a chat message DOM element and re-executes the kingdom check with the specified reroll mode (fame/infamy, creative solution, free-and-fair, or keep highest/lowest).

nodes.name: ActivityManagement.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the ActivityManagement CrudApplication dialog for enabling/disabling and managing homebrew kingdom activities, delegating add/edit to the ModifyActivity dialog.

nodes.name: ActivityManagement
nodes.summary: CrudApplication subclass managing the activity list: list display, enable toggle via blacklist, and add/edit delegation to ModifyActivity.

nodes.name: AddModifier.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the AddModifier FormApp dialog for creating custom kingdom modifiers with typed fields (type, selector, ability, skill, phase, activity, duration) and constructs the RawModifier with applyIf predicates on save.

nodes.name: ModifierModel
nodes.summary: Foundry DataModel subclass defining the schema for the add-modifier form, validating types for name, ModifierType, ModifierSelector, ability/skill/phase enums, value, and duration fields.

nodes.name: AddModifier
nodes.summary: FormApp dialog that collects modifier parameters, builds applyIf predicates from optional ability/skill/phase/activity filters, and invokes the onSave callback with the constructed RawModifier.

nodes.name: ConsumptionBreakdown.kt
nodes.summary: Provides the consumptionBreakdown top-level function that opens a read-only prompt dialog showing the consumption breakdown context.

nodes.name: KingdomCheckDialog.kt
nodes.summary: The primary kingdom skill check dialog: a large FormApp that assembles modifier lists, renders interactive modifier pills (fortune, assurance, creative solution, free-and-fair), resolves the activity DC, and fires the roll via KingdomRoll.

nodes.name: KingdomRoll.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the kingdom dice roll execution layer: buildChatButtons renders clickable modifier buttons in chat, rollCheck performs the d20 roll with fortune/assurance modes and posts the outcome with full degree-of-success resolution.

nodes.name: buildChatButtons
nodes.summary: Renders the Handlebars chat-buttons template for a kingdom roll result, surfacing active modifier buttons tied to the actor UUID and event context.

nodes.name: ModifyActivity.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the ModifyActivity FormApp dialog for creating and editing homebrew kingdom activities, covering title, phase, DC type, skill-rank requirements, action cost, and per-degree result text.

nodes.name: ModifyActivityDataModel
nodes.summary: Foundry DataModel subclass defining the schema for the modify-activity form, validating all RawActivity fields including phase enum, DC type, numeric DC, skill ranks, and result messages.

nodes.name: CalculateIncome.kt
nodes.summary: Implements collectResources which rolls resource dice, applies modifier-based commodity adjustments, posts a chat summary, and returns the capped Income for the End Turn phase; also provides getResourceDiceAmount for computing the dice pool.

nodes.name: collectResources
nodes.summary: Executes the Collect Resources step: calculates base income, adds modifier bonuses for ore/stone/lumber, rolls resource dice, posts a chat template, then merges with existing stockpile and caps by storage.

nodes.name: Consumption.kt
nodes.summary: Implements payConsumption which invokes calculateConsumption, deducts food from the kingdom stockpile, posts shortage warnings to chat when food runs out, and returns the remaining food amount.

nodes.name: payConsumption
nodes.summary: Deducts consumption from the food stockpile and posts a not-enough-food chat template when insufficient, returning the remaining food after payment.

nodes.name: ActivitiesContext.kt
nodes.summary: Builds the ActivitiesContext for the kingdom sheet's activity panels, resolving per-activity skill validity and action costs in parallel, then grouping by phase with per-phase caps from ActivityCapCalculator.

nodes.name: toActivitiesContext
nodes.summary: Assembles the full ActivitiesContext for all kingdom phases in parallel using coroutines, integrating activity caps from ActivityCapCalculator with the per-phase activity lists.

nodes.name: ConsumptionBreakdownContext.kt
nodes.summary: Declares the ConsumptionBreakdownContext JS plain object interface and provides a Consumption.toContext() extension to convert the domain model to a Handlebars-ready view model.

nodes.name: ModifierContext.kt
nodes.summary: Declares ModifierContext for the kingdom sheet modifier list UI and provides Array<RawModifier>.toContext() which translates modifier display names and resolves turn duration labels.

nodes.name: SkillChecksContext.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the skillChecks function which computes the effective bonus for every kingdom skill (applying modifiers and proficiency) and returns SkillChecksContext items driving the skill section of the kingdom sheet.

nodes.name: skillChecks
nodes.summary: Evaluates modifier totals for every KingdomSkill and builds SkillChecksContext entries with proficiency CSS classes, formatted modifier strings, and the appropriate input form element (hidden or select).

nodes.name: HouseRulesDataValidationTest.kt
nodes.summary: Validates that house-rules data entries (companion structures and kingdom activities from JSON) have correct properties, acting as a data-integrity guard for custom content loaded at runtime.

nodes.name: UntrainedProficiencyMode.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the UntrainedProficiencyMode enum (NONE, HALF, FULL) controlling how untrained proficiency is handled in kingdom skill checks, with camelCase serialization and i18n support.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements ValueEnum and Translatable interfaces with companion object factory pattern common across this codebase.

nodes.name: AutomateResources.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the AutomateResources enum (KINGMAKER, TILE_BASED, MANUAL) governing how kingdom resource income is calculated, with camelCase serialization and i18n support.

nodes.name: SettlementTerrain.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the SettlementTerrain enum (FOREST, SWAMP, MOUNTAINS, PLAINS) representing the terrain type of a settlement hex, used when creating settlements and computing terrain-based modifiers.

nodes.name: RawGroup.kt
nodes.summary: Declares the RawGroup JS-interop external interface representing a diplomatic group with negotiation DC, war status, pledge-of-fealty flags, and relations tier persisted on the kingdom actor.

nodes.name: AddEvent.kt
nodes.summary: Provides the AddEvent FormApp dialog for browsing and adding kingdom events to the ongoing event list, including a live search filter, settlement-event placement, and a helper to generate campaign quests from events.

nodes.name: AddEvent
nodes.summary: FormApp subclass rendering an event browser with search, filtering by traits/skills, and click handlers to add or generate quests from kingdom events.

nodes.name: CampaignClockDialog.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the CampaignClockDialog CrudApplication for managing kingdom campaign clocks — supports add, edit, delete, and toggling active state per clock entry.

nodes.name: CampaignClockDialog
nodes.summary: CrudApplication subclass managing the list of campaign clocks attached to the kingdom actor, with full CRUD and active/inactive toggle.

nodes.name: CharterManagement.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the CharterManagement CrudApplication for managing built-in and homebrew kingdom charters, with enable/disable blacklist, ability boost/flaw display, and cleanup of charter state on deletion.

nodes.name: CharterManagement
nodes.summary: CrudApplication for kingdom charters that manages homebrew entries, blacklist toggling, and resets ability boost selections when the active charter is deleted or disabled.

nodes.name: FeatManagement.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the FeatManagement CrudApplication for managing kingdom feats, including homebrew authoring, blacklist toggling, and clearing feat selections on feature rows when a feat is deleted.

nodes.name: FeatManagement
nodes.summary: CrudApplication for kingdom feats that also clears feat choices on RawFeatureChoices rows if the feat is removed from the enabled set.

nodes.name: GovernmentManagement.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the GovernmentManagement CrudApplication for kingdom government types, showing ability boosts and skill proficiency columns, with blacklist toggling and ability-boost reset on active government deletion.

nodes.name: GovernmentManagement
nodes.summary: CrudApplication for government types that resets ability boosts when the active government is deleted and enforces the homebrew/built-in edit boundary.

nodes.name: HeartlandManagement.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the HeartlandManagement CrudApplication for kingdom heartlands, displaying the single ability boost column and managing homebrew entries and blacklist state.

nodes.name: HeartlandManagement
nodes.summary: CrudApplication for heartlands with ability-boost column, blacklist management, and clearing the active heartland choice on deletion.

nodes.name: InspectSettlement.kt
nodes.summary: Provides the InspectSettlement FormApp dialog for viewing and editing a single settlement's details — type, block count, terrain, layout, population NPC roster, available item levels, bonuses, and structure list — with live Foundry scene event listeners for token/tile mutations.

nodes.name: InspectSettlement
nodes.summary: FormApp rendering a multi-tab settlement inspector that listens for Foundry token/tile/scene lifecycle hooks to auto-refresh, and exposes block editing, type/layout overrides, and population NPC management.

nodes.name: KingdomEventManagement.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the KingdomEventManagement CrudApplication for managing the list of available kingdom events, supporting homebrew entries, blacklist toggling, and removal of ongoing events when a definition is deleted.

nodes.name: KingdomEventManagement
nodes.summary: CrudApplication that manages kingdom event definitions and purges any matching ongoing event instances when a definition is deleted.

nodes.name: KingdomSettings.kt
nodes.summary: Implements KingdomSettingsApplication FormApp providing a comprehensive settings dialog for kingdom configuration — event DCs, RP/XP conversions, automation toggles, proficiency mode, pacing-alert thresholds, and variant rules.

nodes.name: KingdomSettingsDataModel
nodes.summary: Foundry DataModel subclass declaring the schema for all kingdom settings fields, enabling form validation and type coercion for the settings dialog.

nodes.name: NewSettlementChoices.kt
nodes.summary: Provides the newSettlementChoices suspend function that shows a prompt dialog collecting name, water borders, terrain, and layout type when creating a new settlement.

nodes.name: PickGroup.kt
nodes.summary: Provides the pickGroup suspend function showing a minimal selection prompt for choosing a diplomatic group from the active list, with error handling for empty lists.

nodes.name: StructureBrowser.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the StructureBrowser FormApp dialog for browsing, filtering, building, repairing, and upgrading settlement structures, with tabs for buildable/repairable/upgradeable/under-construction/free structures and inline RP/commodity cost display.

nodes.name: StructureBrowser
nodes.summary: FormApp rendering a multi-tab structure catalog with level, lot, and search filters, commodity cost rows, and action handlers for build/repair/upgrade/free operations on settlement scenes.

nodes.name: KingdomSheet.kt
nodes.summary: The central KingdomSheet FormApp implementing the primary kingdom actor sheet — orchestrates all kingdom subsystems, renders 12 main-nav tabs, opens sub-dialogs, handles End Turn, resource tracking, armies, settlements, modifiers, quests, and pacing alerts.

nodes.name: KingdomSheet
nodes.summary: FormApp subclass serving as the main kingdom actor sheet; integrates all domain dialogs, handles every click action across 12 nav tabs, assembles context from all sub-modules, and manages Foundry actor lifecycle hooks.
nodes.languageNotes: At 2291 non-empty lines this is the largest single file in the kingdom subsystem — a deliberate orchestration class that wires together all other dialogs and context builders.

nodes.name: CampaignClockContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines CampaignClockContext and CampaignClockCardContext JS-interop interfaces and extension functions that convert an array of CampaignClock domain objects into Handlebars-ready context data including progress percent, expiry, and pause state.

nodes.name: GroupContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the GroupContext JS-interop interface and an extension function converting RawGroup arrays into form-element context objects (text, DC select, checkboxes, relations enum) for the kingdom sheet groups tab.

nodes.name: NavEntryContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the NavEntryContext JS-interop interface and the generic createTabs<T> inline function that converts any Translatable enum into an array of navigation tab context objects for Handlebars rendering.

nodes.name: SettlementsContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines SettlementsContext and settlement-matrix row/cell interfaces, with extension functions that parse RawSettlement arrays into rich context objects covering available item levels, population, block counts, and overcrowding state for the kingdom sheet settlements tab.

nodes.name: MainNavEntry.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the MainNavEntry enum representing the 12 top-level navigation tabs of the kingdom sheet (TURN, KINGDOM, SETTLEMENTS, TRADE_AGREEMENTS, MODIFIERS, QUESTS, ROSTER, PARTY, NOTES, CAMPAIGN, ARMY_PRESSURE, PACING).

nodes.name: TurnNavEntry.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the TurnNavEntry enum representing the 10 sub-tabs within the kingdom turn phase (UPKEEP, COMMERCE, LEADERSHIP, REGION, CIVIC, ARMY, EVENT, CLOCK, XP, END).

nodes.name: RawSettlement.kt
nodes.summary: Declares RawSettlement, RawPopulationRoster, and RawNpcEntry JS-interop external interfaces representing the persisted form of a kingdom settlement including scene binding, layout, terrain, and optional NPC population roster.

nodes.name: Scenes.kt
nodes.summary: Provides Scene extension functions for parsing Foundry scene tiles and structure tokens into typed Settlement domain objects, including block/lot detection, grid overlap calculations for non-infrastructure structures, and settlement drawing utilities.

nodes.name: PopulationPersistenceTest.kt
nodes.summary: Test suite verifying population persistence logic for settlements — covers generating initial NPC populations, applying Migration31 data migrations, and round-tripping roster data through RawSettlement serialization.

nodes.name: Gt.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the `Gt` (greater-than) expression data class used in the kingdom modifier condition evaluation system.

nodes.name: Gte.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the `Gte` (greater-than-or-equal) expression data class for modifier condition predicates.

nodes.name: HasRollOption.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the `HasRollOption` expression data class that checks whether a specific roll option string is present in the evaluation context.

nodes.name: In.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the `In` expression that evaluates whether a needle value exists within a haystack collection, supporting dynamic context variable resolution.

nodes.name: Lt.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the `Lt` (less-than) expression data class for modifier condition predicates.

nodes.name: Lte.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the `Lte` (less-than-or-equal) expression data class for modifier condition predicates.

nodes.name: Not.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the `Not` logical negation expression data class that wraps another boolean expression.

nodes.name: Some.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the `Some` (logical OR) expression data class that evaluates true if any sub-expression is true.

nodes.name: When.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the `When` expression that acts as a conditional switch — evaluates a list of Case predicates and returns the first matching value, falling back to a default.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Kotlin sequence lazy evaluation (`asSequence().mapNotNull().firstOrNull()`) for short-circuit case matching.

nodes.name: AnarchyPenalty.kt
nodes.summary: Provides the `createAnarchyPenalty` factory that builds a modifier which downgrades all degree-of-success results when unrest meets or exceeds the anarchy threshold.

nodes.name: ArmyConditionPenalties.kt
nodes.summary: Defines `ArmyConditionInfo` and the `createArmyConditionPenalties` factory that produces circumstance penalty modifiers for Mired and Weary army conditions gated by phase/activity predicates.

nodes.name: FavoredLandPenalty.kt
nodes.summary: Provides a factory for the favored-land circumstance penalty modifier, applied conditionally when the terrain type does not match the kingdom's favored land.

nodes.name: NoBridgePenalty.kt
nodes.summary: Provides a factory for the no-bridge circumstance penalty modifier applied to certain region activities when no bridge structure is present.

nodes.name: RuinPenalties.kt
nodes.summary: Provides factories for the four ruin (Corruption, Crime, Decay, Strife) penalty modifiers that apply status penalties gated on each respective ruin ability score.

nodes.name: SecondaryTerritoryPenalty.kt
nodes.summary: Provides a factory for the secondary-territory circumstance penalty modifier applied when operating outside the primary kingdom territory.

nodes.name: UnrestPenalty.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the unrest status penalty ladder (`calculateUnrestPenalty`) and the `createUnrestModifier` factory, which scales the status penalty from -1 to -4 based on unrest score thresholds.

nodes.name: VacancyPenalties.kt
nodes.summary: Provides `createVacancyModifiers` which generates one vacancy-type penalty modifier per kingdom leader role, each gated on the corresponding vacancy flag and scoped to the relevant ability or phase.

nodes.name: KingdomModifier.kt
nodes.summary: JS-target bridge layer that declares raw JS-interop interfaces for modifier JSON (RawModifier, RawExpression variants, RawNote) and provides parse/serialize extension functions that convert between the JS object representation and the Kotlin domain model, plus the `checkModifiers` and `createExpressionContext` top-level functions that assemble all active modifiers and evaluation context from KingdomData.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `@JsPlainObject` external interfaces for zero-overhead JS interop; unsafe casts (`unsafeCast`) dispatched on `Object.hasOwn` property checks substitute for sealed-class pattern-matching across the JS boundary.

nodes.name: RawModifier
nodes.summary: External JS-interop interface mirroring the full JSON shape of a kingdom modifier, including optional expression, roll options, upgrade/downgrade results, and notes.

nodes.name: parse (RawExpression<Boolean>)
nodes.summary: Extension function on `RawExpression<Boolean>` that dispatches on JS object keys to construct the correct Kotlin `Expression<Boolean>` subtype (All, Some, Lt, Lte, Gt, Gte, Eq, HasRollOption, In, Not).

nodes.name: parse (RawExpression<Any?>)
nodes.summary: Extension function on `RawExpression<Any?>` that deserializes a raw JS `when` expression into a Kotlin `When` instance with typed Case objects.

nodes.name: parse (RawModifier)
nodes.summary: Extension function on `RawModifier` that fully hydrates a Kotlin `Modifier` domain object from a raw JS shape, resolving enums, generating UUIDs for missing ids, and parsing nested expressions and notes.

nodes.name: checkModifiers
nodes.summary: Suspend function on `KingdomData` that collects all active modifiers from features, feats, government, events, army conditions, and inline modifiers by delegating to `createAllModifiers`, returning the complete modifier list for a given roll context.

nodes.name: createExpressionContext
nodes.summary: Builds an `ExpressionContext` from `KingdomData` by resolving skill ranks, vacancies, roll options from feats, event traits, and settlement-scoped event IDs — the single authoritative context object used to evaluate all modifier predicates.

nodes.name: createArmyConditionPenalties
nodes.summary: Factory that produces circumstance penalty modifiers for Mired and Weary army conditions, each conditionally gated on deploy-army activity or army phase via Eq expressions.

nodes.name: createUnrestModifier
nodes.summary: Factory that creates a nullable status-penalty Modifier based on current unrest score, returning null when unrest is 0.

nodes.name: createVacancyModifiers
nodes.summary: Generates one vacancy-penalty Modifier per leader role, each with an Eq predicate gating on the vacancy flag and scoped to the relevant kingdom ability or phase.

nodes.name: Modifier.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the core `Modifier` data class representing a single kingdom check modifier, carrying its type, value, conditional expression, roll options, fortune/upgrade flags, and i18n metadata.
nodes.languageNotes: Kotlin data class with many optional fields defaulted to empty collections; uses sealed Expression<Boolean> list for conditional application.

nodes.name: ModifierType.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the `ModifierType` enum (ABILITY, PROFICIENCY, ITEM, STATUS, CIRCUMSTANCE, LEADERSHIP, VACANCY, UNTYPED) with Translatable and ValueEnum interfaces for i18n key generation and camelCase serialization.

nodes.name: AbilityBonuses.kt
nodes.summary: Produces one ABILITY-typed `Modifier` per kingdom ability (Culture, Economy, Loyalty, Stability), each conditional on the `@ability` roll option matching that ability's value.

nodes.name: CreativeSolution.kt
nodes.summary: Creates a +2 CIRCUMSTANCE modifier for the Creative Solution feat, enabled when the `creative-solution` roll option is present.

nodes.name: InvestedBonuses.kt
nodes.summary: Calculates and produces STATUS modifiers for invested leader actors; bonus value scales with kingdom level (1/2/3) and is applied per leader's key ability.

nodes.name: LeaderEventBonus.kt
nodes.summary: Creates a level-scaled CIRCUMSTANCE modifier (1–3) for a listed event leader during the Event phase, conditional on the leader not being vacant and matching the event leader role.

nodes.name: LeadershipBonuses.kt
nodes.summary: Computes LEADERSHIP modifiers for each active leader using PC skill ranks or NPC level-based tables, emitting both a full-value specialized modifier and a half-value unspecialized modifier per leader.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses private helper functions per NPC type (regular, highly motivated, non-Pathfinder) and a PC-specific rank-analysis function to determine bonus magnitude.

nodes.name: ProficiencyBonuses.kt
nodes.summary: Generates PROFICIENCY modifiers for all kingdom skills based on proficiency rank (untrained/trained/expert/master/legendary) and kingdom level, with support for an untrained proficiency mode.

nodes.name: RepairBonuses.kt
nodes.summary: Creates a fixed +2 ITEM modifier for the repair-structure activity, enabled when the `repair-structure` roll option is present.

nodes.name: RulerBonus.kt
nodes.summary: Produces an optional ITEM modifier for the Ruler's leadership activity bonus derived from global structure bonuses, applying only during the Leadership phase.

nodes.name: StructureBonuses.kt
nodes.summary: Converts the highest unique settlement structure bonuses into ITEM modifiers keyed by skill or activity, sourced from the merged settlement's `highestUniqueBonuses` list.

nodes.name: StructureEventBonuses.kt
nodes.summary: Creates an optional ITEM modifier for a settlement's event bonus during the Event phase, based on the settlement's `settlementEventBonus` value.

nodes.name: CreateAllModifiers.kt
nodes.summary: Top-level aggregator that builds the complete list of kingdom modifiers by calling all bonus and penalty factory functions with kingdom state inputs (ability scores, leaders, settlements, ruins, unrest, vacancies, army conditions, feat/feature/event modifiers).
nodes.languageNotes: Single exported function combining all modifier categories via list concatenation; the flag `enableLeadershipBonuses` switches between full leadership modifiers and invested bonuses.

nodes.name: EvaluateModifiers.kt
nodes.summary: Evaluates a filtered modifier list: deduplicates by id, resolves value expressions, applies PF2e stacking rules (keep highest per type, keep lowest penalty per type, pass all UNTYPED), and assembles a `ModifierResult` with totals, fortune flags, and upgrade/downgrade sets.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements PF2e's modifier stacking rules: typed modifiers keep only the highest bonus and lowest penalty; UNTYPED modifiers always stack.

nodes.name: All.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the `All` expression that evaluates true only when all contained sub-expressions evaluate to true (logical AND).

nodes.name: Case.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the `Case` expression that conditionally evaluates to a value when its boolean sub-expression is true, or null otherwise; used in `When` chains for dynamic modifier values.

nodes.name: Eq.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the `Eq` expression that evaluates equality between two operands via the `ExpressionContext`, enabling variable-reference comparisons like `@ability == 'culture'`.

nodes.name: Expression.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the `Expression<T>` sealed interface — the base type for all kingdom modifier conditional expressions, requiring an `evaluate(ExpressionContext)` method.

nodes.name: createAbilityModifiers
nodes.summary: Returns a list of four ABILITY-typed Modifiers (one per kingdom ability) each gated by an Eq expression on `@ability`.

nodes.name: createInvestedBonuses
nodes.summary: Builds STATUS modifiers for each invested leader actor, deduplicating by id so the same ability key ability isn't double-counted.

nodes.name: createLeadershipModifiers
nodes.summary: Iterates all Leader entries, computes each leader's bonus via `calculateLeadershipBonus`, and emits a full specialized modifier and a half-value unspecialized modifier per active leader.

nodes.name: calculateLeadershipBonus
nodes.summary: Dispatches to the appropriate NPC or PC bonus calculation function based on `LeaderType`, returning an integer bonus value.

nodes.name: createAllProficiencyModifiers
nodes.summary: Maps every `KingdomSkill` entry to a proficiency modifier by delegating to `createProficiencyModifier`.

nodes.name: createProficiencyModifier
nodes.summary: Builds a single PROFICIENCY modifier for a given skill, computing the numeric value from rank (untrained/trained/expert/master/legendary) and level with optional untrained mode support.

nodes.name: createAllModifiers
nodes.summary: Top-level factory that concatenates every bonus and penalty modifier list from all sub-modules into a single `List<Modifier>` representing the full kingdom modifier pool for a check.

nodes.name: evaluateModifiers
nodes.summary: Applies deduplication, value-expression resolution, PF2e stacking rules, and assembles the final `ModifierResult` with totals, per-type bonuses/penalties, and fortune/upgrade flags.

nodes.name: ArmyPressureView.kt
nodes.summary: Defines pure view-model data classes (WarThreatView, ArmyDeploymentView, WarPressureView, ArmyPressureView) and the exported buildArmyPressureView function that converts raw JS-interop war data into template-ready models with computed fields such as escalation percentage and threshold flags.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Kotlin extension functions on Raw JS-interop types as private mappers; the public API is a single top-level function consumed by the sheet context builder.

nodes.name: ArmyWarPressure.kt
nodes.summary: Pure domain logic for the Army & War Pressure board (roadmap #12): calculates cumulative war-pressure from active threats and supporting armies, advances threat-clock escalation each turn, and exposes KingdomSettings extension accessors — all with no Foundry dependencies so the code is unit-testable.
nodes.languageNotes: All logic is expressed as top-level pure functions and private extension functions on the Raw JS-interop types; constants are declared with const val following Kotlin SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE convention.

nodes.name: ArmyDeploymentStatus.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the ArmyDeploymentStatus enum (DEPLOYED, BATTLE, RETREATED, DESTROYED) implementing Translatable and ValueEnum, providing camelCase serialization values and i18n keys for army lifecycle states.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements two project interfaces (Translatable, ValueEnum) for i18n key generation and camelCase string serialization, matching the JS JSON schema convention.

nodes.name: RawArmyDeployment.kt
nodes.summary: JS-interop external interface for a player army deployment entry on the war board, caching the Foundry PF2EArmy actor UUID, display name, type, current status, and the threat or settlement it is assigned to.
nodes.languageNotes: @JsPlainObject external interface compiles to a plain JS object with no Kotlin class overhead, suitable for direct serialization to/from Foundry's document flags.

nodes.name: RawWarPressure.kt
nodes.summary: JS-interop external interface representing the global war-pressure track: a 0-100 cumulative score driven by active threats and mitigated by deployed armies, with threshold values that trigger unrest/consumption modifiers.
nodes.languageNotes: @JsPlainObject external interface; lastChange is nullable to represent the first-tick baseline state where no prior pressure existed.

nodes.name: RawWarThreat.kt
nodes.summary: JS-interop external interface for an enemy threat entry on the war board, holding the escalation clock (escalationLevel/maxEscalation), ETA countdown, optional target location, linked quest/event IDs, and a pauseOnExpiry flag implementing the Decision 3 soft-pause mechanic.
nodes.languageNotes: Multiple nullable fields reflect optional associations (enemyFaction, linkedQuestId, linkedEventId, triggeredTurn); pauseOnExpiry drives conditional expiry behavior in the tick engine.

nodes.name: WarThreatStatus.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the WarThreatStatus enum (ACTIVE, DEFEATED, EVADED, EXPIRED) implementing Translatable and ValueEnum, providing camelCase serialization values and i18n keys for threat lifecycle states.
nodes.languageNotes: Mirrors the structure of ArmyDeploymentStatus; both enums use toCamelCase() and fromCamelCase() for bidirectional string conversion to match the JS JSON storage format.

nodes.name: AddWarThreat.kt
nodes.summary: ApplicationV2-based FormApp dialog for creating or editing a RawWarThreat on the war board; supports create/edit mode, validates input via a Foundry DataModel schema, and calls back with the assembled threat on save.
nodes.languageNotes: Extends the project's FormApp<C,D> pattern; _preparePartContext builds the Handlebars section/row context, onParsedSubmit stores validated form data, and _onClickAction handles the km-save button action.

nodes.name: DeployArmy.kt
nodes.summary: ApplicationV2-based FormApp dialog for deploying a PF2EArmy actor to the war board; presents a select of available armies and optionally assigns the deployment to an active threat, then calls back with the assembled RawArmyDeployment on save.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Select form inputs exclusively (no free-text); army options are pre-filtered by the caller from the Foundry actor list before being passed into the dialog constructor.

nodes.name: ArmyPressureContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the JS-friendly external interface types (ArmyThreatContext, ArmyDeploymentContext, ArmyPressureMeterContext, ArmyPressureContext) consumed directly by Handlebars templates, and the buildArmyPressureContext function that maps the pure ArmyPressureView to these template-ready structures with localized status labels.
nodes.languageNotes: All context types are @JsPlainObject external interfaces, ensuring they serialize cleanly for Handlebars; statusLabel fields are resolved here via WarThreatStatus/ArmyDeploymentStatus i18n keys so the template needs no logic.

nodes.name: ArmyPressureViewTest.kt
nodes.summary: Unit tests for buildArmyPressureView covering correct mapping of threats, deployments, and pressure from raw data, computed fields (escalationPercent, threshold flags), and the null/empty baseline case.

nodes.name: ArmyWarPressureTest.kt
nodes.summary: Unit tests for recalculateWarPressure and tickWarThreat covering pressure rise per threat, army reduction with zero-clamping, threshold modifier crossing, ETA countdown, escalation on arrival, soft-pause expiry mechanic, and non-active threat passthrough.

nodes.name: buildArmyPressureView
nodes.summary: Assembles an ArmyPressureView from raw arrays of threats, deployments, and optional pressure data along with KingdomSettings, computing display fields and delegating to private extension mappers.

nodes.name: recalculateWarPressure
nodes.summary: Recalculates the global war-pressure track for one turn: counts active threats and supporting armies, computes pressure delta (5 per threat, -2 per army), clamps cumulative pressure to 0-100, and sets unrest/consumption modifiers on threshold crossings.

nodes.name: tickWarThreat
nodes.summary: Advances a single threat by one turn: decrements ETA, escalates when ETA reaches zero or is unknown, transitions to EXPIRED (or stays ACTIVE with triggeredTurn recorded when pauseOnExpiry) when escalation hits max.

nodes.name: buildArmyPressureContext
nodes.summary: Maps an ArmyPressureView to the Handlebars-ready ArmyPressureContext, translating status enum values to localized labels and converting Kotlin lists to JS arrays for template consumption.

nodes.name: AddWarThreat
nodes.summary: FormApp dialog for adding or editing a war threat; builds a single-section Handlebars form with text/number/checkbox inputs, persists validated form data on submit, and assembles the final RawWarThreat on the km-save action.

nodes.name: WarThreatDataModel
nodes.summary: Foundry DataModel subclass providing the schema definition for WarThreat form validation; exported to JS for use as the dataModel option in AddWarThreat.

nodes.name: DeployArmy
nodes.summary: FormApp dialog for deploying a PF2EArmy to the war board; presents select inputs for army choice and optional threat assignment, then assembles and returns a RawArmyDeployment with status DEPLOYED on save.

nodes.name: ArmyDeploymentStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of army deployment lifecycle states (DEPLOYED, BATTLE, RETREATED, DESTROYED) with camelCase serialization values and i18n key accessors.

nodes.name: WarThreatStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of war threat lifecycle states (ACTIVE, DEFEATED, EVADED, EXPIRED) with camelCase serialization values and i18n key accessors.

nodes.name: ArmyPressureViewTest
nodes.summary: Test class exercising buildArmyPressureView with full raw data (verifying computed percent and threshold flags) and null inputs (verifying disabled/empty baseline).

nodes.name: WarPressureCalculationTest
nodes.summary: Test class covering recalculateWarPressure: pressure rise per active threat, army reduction with zero-clamping, non-active threats adding no pressure, threshold modifier activation, and consumptionModifier tracking.

nodes.name: WarThreatTickTest
nodes.summary: Test class covering tickWarThreat: ETA countdown without escalation, escalation on ETA zero, unknown-ETA escalation each turn, expiry on max escalation, soft-pause keeping threat active with triggeredTurn set, and non-active threat passthrough.

nodes.name: PacingAlertChat.kt
nodes.summary: Posts a single balance/pacing advisory alert to Foundry chat by resolving its i18n key and severity label then rendering a Handlebars chat template. Serves as the single dispatch point for all pacing alert chat output (roadmap #13).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a Kotlin suspend function to call the async Foundry chat posting utility; JS interop via dynamic `js("{}")` object for the template context.

nodes.name: postPacingAlertChat
nodes.summary: Suspend function that localizes a RawPacingAlert's message and severity label then posts it to Foundry chat via the pacing-alert Handlebars template.

nodes.name: PacingAlertView.kt
nodes.summary: Defines pure view-model data classes and a builder function for the Balance & Pacing Alerts panel, transforming raw persisted alert history into a sorted, counted, template-ready structure. Designed to be Foundry-free and fully unit-testable.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure Kotlin data classes with no Foundry dependencies; i18n localization is deferred to the sheet context layer to keep this layer testable.

nodes.name: PacingAlertItemView
nodes.summary: Immutable view-model representing a single pacing alert item with its id, type, severity, i18n message key, turn created, and critical flag.

nodes.name: PacingAlertView
nodes.summary: Aggregated view-model for the pacing alert panel, holding hasAlerts flag, warning/critical counts, and the ordered list of PacingAlertItemView entries.

nodes.name: buildPacingAlertView
nodes.summary: Converts a nullable RawPacingAlert array into a PacingAlertView by sorting newest-first, mapping to view items, and computing per-severity counts and the hasAlerts flag.

nodes.name: PacingAlerts.kt
nodes.summary: Pure, Foundry-free pacing evaluation logic for roadmap #13: evaluates level mismatch, unrest stagnation, turn gap, and loot imbalance conditions and emits RawPacingAlerts only when thresholds are crossed or severity changes. Contains threshold accessors on KingdomSettings and fire-once tracker functions to avoid alert spam.
nodes.languageNotes: All functions are pure (no side effects, no Foundry calls); KingdomSettings accessors use extension functions with null-coalescing defaults for backward compatibility.

nodes.name: evaluateLevelMismatch
nodes.summary: Computes whether the kingdom level diverges from the target level beyond the configured range and returns a WARNING or CRITICAL RawPacingAlert, or null if within range.

nodes.name: evaluateStagnation
nodes.summary: Returns a WARNING or CRITICAL stagnation alert when unrest has not changed for too many turns, or null if still within the allowed turn gap.

nodes.name: trackUnrestStagnation
nodes.summary: Advances the unrest-stagnation counter by one turn, resets it when unrest moves, and emits a stagnation alert only the first time the counter reaches the warning or critical threshold to prevent per-turn spam.

nodes.name: evaluateLootImbalance
nodes.summary: Returns a WARNING or CRITICAL loot-imbalance alert when settlement item-access level significantly exceeds the party level, threatening wealth-by-level balance.

nodes.name: evaluatePacingAlerts
nodes.summary: Aggregates all pacing alert evaluations (level mismatch, stagnation, turn gap) for a single turn into a typed array of RawPacingAlerts, using PacingMetrics and KingdomSettings threshold values.

nodes.name: StagnationTrack
nodes.summary: Data class carrying the updated unrest-stagnation counter and an optional fire-once RawPacingAlert after advancing the tracker one turn.

nodes.name: PacingStateTrack
nodes.summary: Data class representing the result of evaluating a persistent pacing condition: the current severity to persist and an alert that fires only when severity newly appears or escalates.

nodes.name: PacingMetrics
nodes.summary: Snapshot data class of the kingdom metrics evaluated each turn for pacing: kingdom level, target level, turns since unrest change, turns since last event, and current turn number.

nodes.name: RawPacingAlert.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the JS-interop data types for the pacing alert subsystem: the RawPacingAlert @JsPlainObject interface for persistence, and the PacingAlertSeverity and PacingAlertType enums with i18n keys and camelCase serialization values.
nodes.languageNotes: @JsPlainObject makes RawPacingAlert directly serializable as a plain JS object for Foundry's actor data storage; enums implement Translatable and ValueEnum for consistent i18n-key and camelCase value patterns used across the codebase.

nodes.name: RawPacingAlert
nodes.summary: JS-plain-object external interface representing a persisted pacing alert with id, type, severity, i18n message key, turn created, and optional related entity id.

nodes.name: PacingAlertSeverity
nodes.summary: Enum of pacing alert severity levels (WARNING, CRITICAL) with camelCase serialization values and i18n translation keys.

nodes.name: PacingAlertType
nodes.summary: Enum of pacing alert types (LEVEL_MISMATCH, STAGNATION, TURN_GAP, LOOT_IMBALANCE) with camelCase values and i18n keys used as the alert message field.

nodes.name: PacingAlertContext.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the Handlebars-ready JS-plain-object context interfaces and builder function for the Balance & Pacing Alerts sheet section, localizing severity labels and alert messages from the pure PacingAlertView into displayable strings.
nodes.languageNotes: Thin localization adapter layer between the pure testable view-model (PacingAlertView) and the Handlebars template; all i18n resolution via t() happens here to keep the view layer free of Foundry calls.

nodes.name: buildPacingAlertContext
nodes.summary: Converts a PacingAlertView into a PacingAlertContext by localizing each alert's severity label and message key via t(), producing a JS-plain-object array ready for Handlebars template rendering.

nodes.name: PacingAlertViewTest.kt
nodes.summary: Unit tests for buildPacingAlertView covering empty/null history, newest-first ordering, severity counting, critical flagging, and message key preservation for localization.

nodes.name: PacingAlertViewTest
nodes.summary: Test class with five kotlin.test cases verifying all aspects of buildPacingAlertView: null/empty guards, turn-based ordering, severity counts, isCritical flag, and i18n key passthrough.

nodes.name: HexDiscovery.kt
nodes.summary: Pure domain logic for hex content discovery: visibility state transitions (hidden/discovered/cleared), encounter suppression rules, travel modifier aggregation, and composite marker selection with priority ordering by content type.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a priority list + minByOrNull pattern to pick the single highest-priority content marker per hex without runtime dispatch.

nodes.name: nextVisibility
nodes.summary: Computes the next HexContentVisibility given a DiscoveryEvent, implementing idempotent state transitions (hidden→discovered, hidden/discovered→cleared, any→hidden on reset).

nodes.name: contentMarkerFor
nodes.summary: Selects a single composite MarkerSpec (icon, label, tint, priority) for a hex by picking the highest-priority visible HexContent according to the CONTENT_TYPE_PRIORITY list.

nodes.name: HexDrawingHelpers.kt
nodes.summary: Visual constants and pure predicate helpers for hex drawing layers: explored (dashed blue), cleared (dotted orange), and road (solid brown). Used by the Foundry drawing sync layer to decide which overlays to create/delete.
nodes.languageNotes: All constants are top-level Kotlin const vals; helpers are pure single-expression functions testable without Foundry runtime.

nodes.name: DegreeChange.kt
nodes.summary: Data class and function for applying upgrade/downgrade modifier sets to a DegreeOfSuccess, returning both the original and final degree as a DegreeChange pair.

nodes.name: determineDegree
nodes.summary: Applies the most significant upgrade and downgrade modifiers to a DegreeOfSuccess, using groupBy+maxBy to pick the highest repeat count per upgrade/downgrade tier.

nodes.name: EvaluateStructures.kt
nodes.summary: Core settlement evaluation engine: computes consumption reduction, structure bonuses (stacking rules), available items by group, and constructs a fully-evaluated Settlement from raw structure lists and settlement metadata.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a Kotlin value class (MergedSettlement) for type-safe capital fallback merging without boxing overhead.

nodes.name: evaluateSettlement
nodes.summary: Constructs a fully-evaluated Settlement from SettlementData and a list of Structure records, computing bonuses, consumption, storage, available items, population, and construction state in one pass.

nodes.name: parseAvailableItems
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-ItemGroup item bonuses across all structures, separating always-stacking from non-stacking rules and folding them into an AvailableItemBonuses result.

nodes.name: evaluateGlobalBonuses
nodes.summary: Aggregates cross-settlement global bonuses (unlocked activities, leadership activity bonuses, leadership activity increase flag) from a list of evaluated settlements.

nodes.name: Storage.kt
nodes.summary: Calculates total kingdom commodity storage capacity by summing the base capacity from kingdom size with per-settlement storage bonuses from all structures.

nodes.name: GainedUnrest.kt
nodes.summary: Data class holding the breakdown of unrest gained per source (war, overcrowded settlements, secondary territory, ruler vacancy) for display and accumulation logic.

nodes.name: Unrest.kt
nodes.summary: Computes a GainedUnrest breakdown from kingdom state (at-war flag, settlement overcrowding, secondary territory presence, ruler vacancy) for use during kingdom turn processing.

nodes.name: RawCharacterCompanionFieldsTest.kt
nodes.summary: Unit tests verifying that companion-tracking fields (influence, campAvailable, discoveryStatus, personalQuestIds) default correctly and round-trip on RawCharacter, while existing fields remain unaffected.

nodes.name: HexDiscoveryTest.kt
nodes.summary: Comprehensive unit tests for HexDiscovery.kt: visibility state machine transitions, encounter suppression logic, travel modifier aggregation, and contentMarkerFor priority selection and icon/tint resolution.

nodes.name: HexStateTest.kt
nodes.summary: Unit tests for hex explored/claimed state transitions and drawing decision helpers from HexDrawingHelpers.kt, using an in-test mirror data class to avoid Foundry runtime dependency.

nodes.name: ZoneLabelTest.kt
nodes.summary: Unit tests for zone label grouping and centroid computation logic, verifying all 20 Kingmaker zones are correctly labelled using average hex position as the placement center.

nodes.name: ArmyCompendiumEntries.kt
nodes.summary: Creates or idempotently updates army, tactic, and modifier JournalEntry compendium records on module startup, using deterministic FNV-1a/xorshift32 IDs and HTML content builders for army stats, tactic actions, and modifier tables.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Kotlin coroutines (suspend + await) for all Foundry async compendium API calls; deterministic ID generation ensures re-runs are safe and idempotent.

nodes.name: createArmyCompendiumEntries
nodes.summary: Entrypoint that checks for missing army/tactic/modifier entries in the journal pack and batch-creates them, temporarily unlocking the locked compendium and restoring lock state in a finally block.

nodes.name: ArmyConsumption.kt
nodes.summary: Registers Foundry hooks to recalculate and persist total army consumption whenever army actors are created, updated, or deleted, or when scenes change.

nodes.name: registerArmyConsumptionHooks
nodes.summary: Wires up TypedHooks for all token/item/actor/scene lifecycle events to trigger army consumption recalculation when PF2EArmy actors are involved.

nodes.name: updateArmyConsumption
nodes.summary: Iterates all kingdom actors, sums consumption from all visible linked army tokens in the configured folder, and persists the updated value to each kingdom's data.

nodes.name: Modifiers.kt
nodes.summary: Extension functions on PF2EArmy to retrieve the numeric badge value of mired and weary status effects by slug lookup.

nodes.name: Tactics.kt
nodes.summary: Extension properties and functions on PF2ECampaignFeature and PF2EArmy for army tactic identification, tactic membership checking, and loading all available tactics from the kingmaker-features compendium pack plus world items.

nodes.name: ChangeDegree.kt
nodes.summary: Parses upgrade metadata from a chat message DOM element and applies an upgrade or downgrade to the roll's DegreeOfSuccess, then posts the changed result as a new complex degree-of-success chat message.

nodes.name: changeDegree
nodes.summary: Reads roll metadata from an HTMLElement dataset, upgrades or downgrades the degree one step, and delegates to postComplexDegreeOfSuccess; logs an error if the degree is already at an extreme.

nodes.name: ChatButtons.kt
nodes.summary: Registers click handlers for all kingdom chat message action buttons (pay structure, gain/lose resources, gain fame, resolve events, set structure HP, add ongoing events, apply modifier effects) via the Foundry chat log render hook.

nodes.name: bindChatButtons
nodes.summary: Hooks into onRenderChatLog to bind click listeners on all registered chat button CSS classes, routing each to its typed callback with the resolved kingdom actor.

nodes.name: ContextMenus.kt
nodes.summary: Registers context menu entries on kingdom roll chat messages for reroll modes (fame, creative solution, default, keep-highest, keep-lowest, Free-and-Fair RP) and degree upgrade/downgrade actions.

nodes.name: registerContextMenus
nodes.summary: Hooks into onGetChatMessageContextOptions to push all kingdom-specific context menu entries with per-entry condition and callback functions.

nodes.name: findKingdomActor
nodes.summary: Extension function on Element that traverses the chat message DOM to find the embedded kingdom actor UUID and resolves it to a KingdomActor with an active kingdom.

nodes.name: DailyTickEngine.kt
nodes.summary: Pure-logic daily tick engine (Kotlin object) responsible for companion travel ETA countdown; tickTravelEta decrements ETA by elapsed days and returns arrival/still-traveling state.
nodes.languageNotes: Implemented as a Kotlin object (singleton) with pure functions so it can be unit-tested without any Foundry runtime dependency.

nodes.name: RawWorksites.kt
nodes.summary: JsPlainObject external interfaces defining the raw JSON schema for worksite data (quantity and resources per site type: farmlands, lumber camps, mines, quarries, luxury sources).

nodes.name: ActorActions.kt
nodes.summary: ApplicationV2 dialog for kingdom/camping data management on a PF2EParty actor: supports export/import via JSON file picker and reset (with confirmation) for both kingdom and camping subsystems.

nodes.name: ActorActions
nodes.summary: SimpleApp subclass rendering export/import/reset actions for a party actor's kingdom and camping data, routing button clicks to the appropriate JSON download, file picker upload, or confirmed clear operations.

nodes.name: AddSettlementBlock.kt
nodes.summary: Awaitable prompt dialog for adding a settlement block, collecting shape (enum), x, and y coordinate inputs via a generic form template and returning an AddSettlementBlockChoices result.

nodes.name: AskDc.kt
nodes.summary: Minimal awaitable prompt dialog that presents a DC select dropdown for a given kingdom activity name and returns the chosen integer DC value.

nodes.name: AskRp.kt
nodes.summary: Awaitable prompt dialog presenting a range select (1..maxRp) for committing resource points toward structure construction, returning the chosen RP amount.

nodes.name: ConfigureLeaderKingdomSkills.kt
nodes.summary: FormApp dialog rendering an 8-leader x 16-skill checkbox matrix for configuring which kingdom skills each leader grants, with optional read-only mode and a DataModel-backed validation schema.

nodes.name: ConfigureLeaderKingdomSkills
nodes.summary: FormApp subclass that renders a leader/skill checkbox grid, validates submissions via ConfigureLeaderKingdomSkillsModel, and invokes the onSave callback with the converted RawLeaderKingdomSkills.

nodes.name: ConfigureLeaderKingdomSkillsModel
nodes.summary: DataModel subclass that defines the Foundry schema for the leader-skills form using the DSL buildSchema, mapping each Leader to a nested object of KingdomSkill boolean fields.

nodes.name: ConfigureLeaderSkills.kt
nodes.summary: Provides the leader-skill configuration dialog, allowing the GM to assign kingdom skills and custom lores to each of the eight leader roles, with optional read-only mode.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a Foundry DataModel (ConfigureLeaderSkillsModel) for schema validation plus a private FormApp subclass; the public API is the top-level configureLeaderSkills() launcher function.

nodes.name: ConfigureLeaderSkillsModel
nodes.summary: Foundry DataModel that defines a boolean-array schema for each of the eight leader roles, used to validate the XY-form submission.

nodes.name: DeleteSettlement.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the deleteSettlementDialog suspend function, which presents a confirmation prompt asking whether the associated Foundry scene should also be deleted.

nodes.name: HomebrewProfileManager.kt
nodes.summary: Implements the HomebrewProfileManagerApplication, a CRUD dialog that lists, adds, edits, and deletes homebrew rule profiles stored in Foundry game settings, with single-active-profile selection.

nodes.name: HomebrewProfileManagerDataModel
nodes.summary: Foundry DataModel with a string-array schema for the list of enabled profile IDs, used by the homebrew manager form submission.

nodes.name: HomebrewProfileManagerApplication
nodes.summary: CrudApplication subclass that manages homebrew profile CRUD operations, persisting the active profile registry to game settings on every change.

nodes.name: KingdomSizeHelp.kt
nodes.summary: Provides the kingdomSizeHelp suspend function that opens a read-only reference table listing kingdom size tiers, resource die sizes, control-DC modifiers, and commodity capacity.

nodes.name: KingdomSkillPicker.kt
nodes.summary: Implements KingdomSkillPicker, a FormApp dialog for selecting a subset of kingdom skills optionally with minimum proficiency ranks, used for feats and event skill assignment.

nodes.name: KingdomSkillPickerModel
